description: Stepping Stones rules (src/rules/steppingStones.js). `crossings`: generateHops(baseNumber, rng) with rng = createSeededRandom(seed).next from a fresh generator — per hop i = 1…numStones, a Fisher-Yates of the distractor pool (candidates target+1, target-1, target+2, target-2, target+base, target+base+1, dropping non-positive, the target, earlier multiples and repeats), keep the first choicesPerHop-1, then a Fisher-Yates of [correct, ...kept]. `path`: buildPath(numStones), percent positions of the rocks (no draws).
